verdict.rationale: Vercel's marketplace lists a Database category and a Neon integration described as serverless Postgres with autoscaling and instant branching, so Postgres can be provisioned through a third-party marketplace partner rather than a first-party Vercel service. Nothing in the evidence documents point-in-time recovery, read replicas, or high availability for that database. Missing for 10: first-party managed Postgres, documented point-in-time recovery, replicas, high-availability guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
